# si-didy-close

> L1 upgrade · wires fallresolve into si-didy session close · Ed25519 signed audit chain per session · CID-anchored in FallPod

si-didy-close is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
